what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Mexico in all host countries combined: people who have asked for protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 236810 Mexican asylum seekers, and the United States hosts the largest share, 88.6%.
Canada is the next largest host.

why.text: The sources here don't say why people left Mexico.
The only armed conflict UCDP records for Mexico in this data is one over the government with the EPR in 1996.

when.text: The number of Mexican asylum seekers rose from 13058 in 2000 to 236810 in 2025, its highest.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025; earlier big changes came in several years from 2000 to 2015.

how.text: These are year-end totals of people whose claims had not yet been decided; refugees from Mexico are counted in a separate series.
People displaced inside Mexico are counted separately by UNHCR and by IDMC, and their figures are never added.
The sources don't say which routes people took.
